notablePrerequisites: Pride Sovereign does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Pride Sovereign by paying {W}, tapping and exerting Pride Sovereign, creating two 1/1 Cat creature tokens.
The Cat tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm twice, untapping all creatures.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Cat token, adding {W}.
Repeat.
